12.  The  Trust  shall  be  capable  in  law  to  take  and  hold
property, movable or immovable, which may become vested
in  it  by  virtue  of  any  purchase,  grant,  gift,  testamentary
disposition or otherwise and all such property shall be held
by the Trust for the purposes of this Act.
13.  The  members  of  the  Board  may  be  remunerated  in
such manner as may, from time to time, be determined by the
Minister with the concurrence of the Minister to whom the
subject of Finance has been assigned.
